Bagchi's package is significantly higher compared to previous CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan's total remuneration. HDFC Bank is seeking shareholder approval for this proposed compensation and Bagchi's appointment. His leadership aims to improve retail loan growth and strengthen investor confidence.

This is the company's first interim dividend post-demerger, reinforcing the company's focus on delivering value to shareholders as it enters a new phase as a more focused and diversified natural resources company, the company stated in an exchange filing.
